notes: v60 releases a with-statement COM interface prefix ("with Make do begin ... end") when the with statement ends instead of at routine exit -- GOD's compiler commit 407ef9bb3a (2026-09-19, compiler/tgobj.pas, +15 lines, UT_HolderVerbose scenario 3c: a with-prefix temp allocated at the with statement but freed only after the nested body had advanced the statement counter was never matched by the end-of-statement release, so the interface leaked until routine exit; the fix re-stamps the temp to the freeing statement). GOD measured UT_HolderVerbose 24/24, created=2019 destroyed=2019 live=0 on the fixed compiler. Compiler-binary-only refresh on v59: no PPU format, RTL or package change, so UNITS ARE STILL THE v52 SET and auto-update.bat can take the ~3.4 MB bin tarball alone; every bin/ member but ppcx64.exe is byte-identical to v59 (18/18 measured). date: above is the compiler's own -iD stamp (the compiler stamps the source-commit date), cut_date: is when these bytes were cut and published. Cut by Bruno (BuildMaster_lazdev) on GOD's orders mu8wfodj (2026-09-19) and mucrbmvr (2026-09-22, STAT) in a scratch clone -- Otto (FPCDeveloper) owns this dist and was mailed the full evidence the same hour. VERIFIED on this box: self-host fixpoint stage2 == stage3; both lifetime matrices (tests/test/tintfstmttemp1.pp, tintfstmttemp2.pp) 60/60 with the v60 Linux compiler at -O- and -O2; WIN64 RUNTIME under wine64 on these exact bytes: this ppcx64.exe compiled both matrices against the v52 units and the products ran 32/32 and 28/28 (created=27 destroyed=27 live=0); controls: the published v59 exe also 60/60 (regression control), the published v58 exe 35 FAILS (the harness can fail). HONEST LIMITS: (1) no reproducer for the scenario-3c leak was found here -- sixteen with-prefix corners pass on BOTH v59 and v60, so the fix's effect is attested by GOD's UT_HolderVerbose run, not measured on this box; what is measured is that the fix is in the bytes and regresses nothing the 60 corners cover. (2) wine is NOT Windows: v59 ran on native Windows (2026-09-17); v60 has so far run only under wine64 -- GOD's IHolder<> test on real Windows is the sign-off. Full record: dist/RELEASE-v60.txt and dist/win64/staging-v60/VERSION.txt.
